notes: All raw values are whole cells. No commodity, deposit-type or status tokenization occurs here. Row examples use 1-based data-record order, excluding header rows.

USGS REE located and nonspatial tables are separately audited. Country contains trailing spaces and historical names. Status and P_Status represent different concepts; a geological Deposit or Occurrence is not operating status.
USGS REE supporting boundary, reference and abbreviation tables are counted separately and are not additional mineral records. Abbreviations include units.
USGS global critical LOCATION is the original geographic label, not guaranteed to be a current ISO country. Point and polygon layers remain distinct.

USGS U.S. critmin is a comma-delimited commodity list. depcat is a historical producer/resource category, not evidence of current operation. minsystem is a separate mineral-system classification, not a deposit-type synonym.

Laterites CSV is MacRoman with CR newlines and quoted embedded CR. CountryCode uses non-ISO source codes. Ni/Co grade-header observations count headers once and do not assert that every row contains a meaningful cobalt estimate.

MRDS code_list is space-delimited, as documented by About.txt. Commodity.code and Commodity.commod are separate code/name evidence. Names.status describes name history, not mine status. Materials.material is a mineral assemblage, not an independently inferred commodity.

MRDS Place.fips is a prefixed FIPS place identifier, not ISO: numeric codes include U.S. subnational units and alphabetic codes include countries. No spatial or country inference is made. Child-table row counts need not equal MRDS.txt; foreign-key reconciliation belongs to normalization.

Jasansky facilities preserve facility and sub-site identity. Country and GID_0 are separate source fields. Facility_type is not a geological deposit type. Activity_status is recorded only where populated; production dates do not supply an inferred operating status.

ga_critical_2025: Australia is the source scope, not a country-value column. Compound Commodity Group values and +/- qualifiers are retained verbatim. The About sheet holds summary counts rather than deposit records.
ga_critical_2025_arcgis: Australia is the declared source scope; no country-value field exists. State codes are admin1, not countries.
ga_global_ree/ga_global_ree/2026-10-31/148953_01_0.xlsx: non-record sheets omitted: ['References'].

ga_global_ree: the global REE compilation has no commodity-code column. All three repeated Deposit type columns are scanned. Element is a tectonic geography field, not a chemical symbol. REE and individual oxide assay column headings remain in table.fields; no commodity row values are fabricated from the declared REE scope. CRIRSCO compliance fields are not operating status.
gseu_crm/gseu_crm/2026-10-29/Data_CRM_deposits_ABC_2024.xlsx: non-record sheets omitted: ['Sheet1'].

gseu_crm: Data column M takes its exact status label from row1; other headers are row2. Deposit sizes is a source code/threshold table, distinct from deposit records; chemical reporting forms are inventoried separately.
icmm/icmm/2026-10-29/global-mining-dataset-1-5.xlsx: non-record sheets omitted: ['About', 'Supplement Sheet'].
icmm: Asset Type is a facility category, not mine operating status. Names and source-provider codes are excluded from commodity extraction.

jasansky: all CSV tables scanned; material_ids.csv is the full source codebook, materials_covered.xlsx is its coverage subset. facilities.gpkg is inventoried by the geospatial extractor. variables_descriptions.xlsx describes fields rather than records and is not counted as observations.

oecd_export: COMMODITY uses CL_PRODUCT_HS2007; REF_AREA uses CL_AREA. Every observed code is joined to its exact English structural label. OBS_STATUS describes observations, not mine operating status, so is excluded.

usgs_mcs_2026: CSV is Windows-1252 (e.g. byte0x97 em dash); decoded without replacement. Commodity/Country are scanned, not commodity mentions in Notes or Statistics_detail. No deposit or operating-status field exists.
wapha: both active and inactive workbooks scanned exhaustively; neither includes a country-value column.
